campaign.fx.hq: Rat HQ: lose it and you lose the war
campaign.fx.capital: Cat Empire Capital: take it and you win the war
campaign.fx.hospital: Field Hospital: whole squad Stress −10 each turn
campaign.fx.recruit: Recruiting Office: new volunteers every turn
campaign.fx.artillery: Artillery Position: +1 mortar shell in every battle
campaign.special.b1.name: Dunk Beach Evacuation
campaign.special.b1.brief: Buy time for our encircled troops to board the boats. Hold the cat vanguard at the beach dunes.
campaign.special.b1.slide.0: Ten days into the war. The border had collapsed, and three hundred thousand Republic troops were trapped on Dunk Beach.
campaign.special.b1.slide.1: Fishing boats, ferries, pleasure cruisers… anything that floated headed for the beach.
campaign.special.b1.slide.2: Imperial dive bombers tore the sky apart. Sand shot up like blood.
campaign.special.b1.slide.3: Someone had to stay on the dunes until the last boat left. That was our squad.
campaign.special.b2.name: Street Fighting in Stalgard
campaign.special.b2.brief: The Imperial army is pouring into the factory city of Stalgard. Hold every brick, every stairwell.
campaign.special.b2.slide.0: The factory city of Stalgard, heart of the Republic. The Imperial army came with the winter.
campaign.special.b2.slide.1: Among the toppled smokestacks, snipers stilled even their breath.
campaign.special.b2.slide.2: A week for a street. A day for a room. There was always a cat at the end of the hall.
campaign.special.b2.slide.3: “There is no ground to fall back to beyond this city.” — Stalgard Garrison
campaign.special.b3.name: Siege of the Arven Forest
campaign.special.b3.brief: The snowbound Arven Forest. Under cover of thick fog, the Empire's last counteroffensive has begun. Hold out inside the encirclement.
campaign.special.b3.slide.0: Winter in the Arven Forest. In the foxholes, the feeling in our toes was the first casualty.
campaign.special.b3.slide.1: The clank of steel came out of the fog. The Empire wasn't finished yet.
campaign.special.b3.slide.2: Offered terms of surrender, the battalion commander answered in one word: “Squeak.”
campaign.special.b3.slide.3: Hold out, and the sky will clear. When the sky clears, our planes will come.
campaign.special.b4.name: Tank Battle on the Kurk Plains
campaign.special.b4.brief: Across endless wheat fields, both armies' tanks collide. Push up to the flag on the ridge.
campaign.special.b4.slide.0: The Kurk Plains. Steel stretched to the horizon.
campaign.special.b4.slide.1: For three months, the sappers dug trenches and buried mines in the wheat.
campaign.special.b4.slide.2: Close enough for the gun barrels to touch. Black smoke covered the sky.
campaign.special.b4.slide.3: By sundown, the only tanks still standing on the plain were ours.
campaign.special.b5.name: Norman Coast Landing
campaign.special.b5.brief: Land along the Empire's fortified coast. Take down the officer commanding the bunker and secure the beachhead.
campaign.special.b5.slide.0: At dawn, after the storm passed, the Republic fleet covered the sea.
campaign.special.b5.slide.1: Inside the landing craft. Some prayed. Some chewed cheese.
campaign.special.b5.slide.2: The moment the ramp dropped, bullets rained down on the beach.
campaign.special.b5.slide.3: The fortress on the cliff. Bring that down and the way opens.
campaign.special.b6.name: Assault on Arn Bridge
campaign.special.b6.brief: This is the only bridge across the river. Paratroopers hold one end. Take down the garrison commander and seize the bridge.
campaign.special.b6.slide.0: The sky turned white with parachutes. The objective: Arn Bridge.
campaign.special.b6.slide.1: We ran through a small town toward the bridge.
campaign.special.b6.slide.2: We secured our end of the bridge. But tanks were coming from the other side.
campaign.special.b6.slide.3: “When are reinforcements coming?” The radio didn't answer.
campaign.special.b7.name: The Fall of Felinburg
campaign.special.b7.brief: The Imperial capital. Take down the captain of the Chancellor's Guard and the war is over.
campaign.special.b7.slide.0: That night, the sky over the Imperial capital was as bright as day.
campaign.special.b7.slide.1: Republic tanks pushed in between the fallen columns. A giant cat statue came down.
campaign.special.b7.slide.2: In his underground bunker, the Chancellor shouted at armies on a map. Those armies were already gone.
campaign.special.b7.slide.3: Two hundred steps to the palace roof. One last step remains.
campaign.prologue.0: The Republic of Ratteria. A land of cheese, chimneys, and sewers. That summer was peaceful.
campaign.prologue.1: To the north, the Chancellor of the Felinian Empire declared: “The land of rats is the table of cats.”
campaign.prologue.2: On the first night of the bombing, the citizens hid deep in the sewers.
campaign.prologue.3: Sewer HQ. Taking back the stolen land inch by inch. That is our war.
campaign.victory.0: The Republic's flag rose over Felinburg. The war was over.
campaign.victory.1: Remembering the names of those who never came home.
campaign.defeat.0: Sewer HQ fell. The Republic's flag came down.
campaign.defeat.1: Still, a few slipped away into the dark. To return someday.
